Get translation values by key path or by key prefix, from one layer or from every layer that defines them. Use "*" as the locale to read from all locales.

## Synopsis

```bash
the-i18n-cli get --locale <locale>
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | `string` | no | — | Layer name from discover (e.g., "root", "app-admin"). Omit to read every layer and get the { byLayer } shape back. |
| `--locale` | `string` | yes | — | Locale code, locale file name, or "*" to read all locales. Examples: "en", "en-US", "en-US.json", "*". |
| `--keys` | `string` | no | — | Dot-separated key paths to read. Example: ["common.actions.save", "auth.login.title"]. Either this or keyPrefix is required. Comma-separated. |
| `--keyPrefix` | `string` | no | — | Namespace to read every leaf key under, dots included: "auth" reads auth.login.title and everything else below auth. Either this or keys is required; passing both reads the union. |
| `--limit` | `string` | no | — | Maximum number of keys to return. Default: 100 for a tool call, unlimited at a terminal. When the cap applies the result carries truncated: true and nextOffset — call again with offset set to that value for the next page, or narrow the request instead. |
| `--offset` | `string` | no | — | Number of keys to skip before returning any. Default: 0. Pass the nextOffset of a truncated result to continue where it stopped. |
